plain: Agreement or consent, as between officials or judges

webster.text: A meeting or coming together; union; conjunction.

more.text: A meeting of minds; agreement in opinion; union in design; implying joint approbation.
Agreement or consent, implying joint aid or contribution of power or influence.

example.quote: That the Congress shall not declare War Without the concurrence of two-thirds of the Senators and Representatives present in each House.
example.cite: Ratification of the Constitution by the State of New York, July 26, 1788
